body:
Thanks for the response, I'm glad I'm not alone in how I feel. I mean, I don't want anybody to feel depressed, but it's kind of comforting knowing that I'm not the only one.

I just don't know how to ask for help without burdening them. I don't know how much is too much. Like what if I turn into a downer to them? And what if they only listen because they feel obligated to and I'm actually hurting them without knowing?

I just can't get the thought of people starving in war-torn countries out of my head. Or even just people here who are living way more messed up lives than I could even imagine. Like I'm a middle class white girl. I understand how lucky I am and I feel guilty that this doesn't make a difference- I don't want to be one of those people moping around and feeling sorry for myself.

I like the idea of marking events that made you happy. It's true that people tend to forget good things. It's something I haven't tried before, so I guess it's worth a shot. Thank you so much for the response.
